source_code_evidence.current_true_tcn: scripts/train_rawframe_model.py defines true_temporal_convnet_region_grid as an allowed from-scratch architecture, accepts B,T,R,C,H,W input, applies a shared scratch 2D region/frame encoder, collapses regions with attention per frame, then runs temporal TCN blocks.
source_code_evidence.current_region_axis_contract: RawFrameClipDataset with preserve_region_axis=True prepares rgb_regions as T,R,C,H,W and batches as B,T,R,C,H,W.
source_code_evidence.current_limitation_for_design_review: The current true TCN collapses region tokens before temporal modeling, so region-specific motion over time can be lost before the temporal stack sees it.

selected_design_proposal.name: Scratch region-temporal late-fusion TCN contract
selected_design_proposal.summary: For the next no-training scaffold, add a named from-scratch architecture/input contract that preserves rgb_regions as B,T,R,C,H,W, encodes each region/frame with a shared small scratch 2D encoder, applies temporal modeling per region before region fusion, then fuses region streams with a lightweight learned-from-scratch attention or late-fusion head. The scaffold must be compile/no-grad/parameter-count only and must not fit a model.
why_this_is_the_selected_proposal: It directly targets M3CC ranks 1-3: optimization/capacity, inductive bias, and temporal weakness, while using the already verified repaired region tensors.
It targets the current true TCN design risk that region information is collapsed before temporal modeling.
It preserves the M3CB-proved input path and does not require source, split, manifest, tensor, crop, or label mutation.
It can be reviewed in a compile-only local slice before any separate future fitting or compute receipt.

proposed_blocks: shared scratch 2D crop encoder applied to B*T*R region frames
per-region temporal stack over each region stream before region collapse
lightweight late fusion across region streams using learned-from-scratch region attention or concatenated region pooling
small classifier head over fused temporal representation
compile_only_requirements_for_next_slice: new architecture is selectable by a named architecture id
build_model creates it without loading weights or external assets
one no-grad forward accepts B,T,R,C,H,W and returns B,5 logits
parameter count is reported and compared to 1290470
no checkpoint, tensor, manifest, model-card, browser, or export artifact is written

optimization_and_regularization_contract.initial_candidate_optimizer: AdamW or Adam, selected in a separate future training receipt only
optimization_and_regularization_contract.augmentation_constraint: region-axis-preserving training path currently requires training_augmentation=none unless a separate no-training augmentation contract changes that safely

comparison_against_m3cc_alternatives.reason: Crop/region adequacy remains plausible, especially for pen, but M3CB proved the current region-axis path is mechanically valid and M3BV memorized through it. Because M3CA also failed train-all sanity, a crop-only audit is less directly targeted than first preserving region-specific temporal streams before fusion.

Split and signer distribution are real held-out risks, but they cannot fully explain the 125-clip train-all failure. Data/split auditing remains a fallback if a reviewed architecture scaffold still cannot satisfy train-sanity criteria.

The selected proposal concretizes this alternative by moving temporal modeling before region collapse and requiring a compile-only scaffold. A second generic design comparison would be lower signal than writing the scaffold contract next.

A curriculum is useful only after the architecture contract exists and can be compiled. Any fitting remains blocked behind a separate future receipt with command, caps, kill conditions, copyback, cleanup, duplicate-worker avoidance, and current human approval for spend if Brev is used.
M3CB found no concrete local defect to validate, and M3CA already failed train-all sanity despite a valid input path. A retry without a reviewed change remains wasteful and unauthorized.

early_stop_conditions_for_future_fitting: stop before training if the scaffold fails no-grad B,T,R,C,H,W forward or logits shape B,5
stop before training if parameter count exceeds the hard 2500000 parameter ceiling
stop before training if the loader falls back to rgb_frames or mutates manifests/tensors
stop if the tiny one-clip-per-label gate fails to reach 0.99 accuracy by 120 epochs
stop if fresh5 train-all accuracy cannot exceed 0.6 after 30 epochs or loss drop is less than 0.3

stop before Brev if there is no current human approval and compute receipt with max runtime, max spend, kill condition, expected signal, artifact copyback, cleanup/default-off verification, and duplicate-worker avoidance
stop before export, browser activation, model-card promotion, active-label promotion, or final-gate change unless a later receipt satisfies the existing final gates
